model_annotation: The pie chart depicts the results of a survey question about the degree to which awareness is integrated into the product development process in a certain organization. A total of 77 responses were collected. The majority of respondents, 25%, believe that awareness is "integrated." The second most common response, at 24%, is "somewhat", indicating that awareness is somewhat integrated. A comparable number of respondents, 20%, feel that awareness is "lacking/integrated." The smallest percentages are for "not integrated at all at all" and "not integrated at all", with 8 and 10 responses respectively. The largest segment of the pie chart corresponds to the "integrated/no more than" category. The chart does not contain a legend, and there are no indication of percentages or emphasis within the segments. No further analytical categorization or explanation of the categories is given.
